summary: ADS-TEC Energy filed a Form 6-K reporting warrant-related transactions and share issuances. Lucerne Master Fund acquired and then cancelled Ayrton/Anson warrants and SPA rights for aggregate cash consideration of $12,556,857.89, cancelling 742,924 warrants (1,084,360 remain). Separately, Lucerne exercised 5,172,045 warrants at an adjusted exercise price of $1.00/share, raising $5,172,045 in aggregate proceeds, which the company intends to use for warrant cancellations. Subscription agreements on May 8, 2026, also raised funds. The filing describes a capital restructuring via warrant exercises and cancellations, effectively returning capital to the company and reducing overhang. Watch for remaining Ayrton/Anson warrant overhang and further dilution management.
